head: Inward Photo brings back old photos from your phone, offline
dek: Inward is a private, offline way to browse the thousands of photos and videos already on your phone, with a shuffled feed and other views; no account or uploads. It was #22 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: You can share a memory through Messages or other apps. It came out on 3 November, costs $4.99, by Riley Mangubat.
means: If your camera roll is too big to look through, it shows you old moments without sending anything to the cloud.
todo: Find Inward Photo in the App Store.
